documents.text: The deployment pipeline requires passing unit tests before release. Production deploys require approval from the release owner. Rollback restores the last approved artifact.
Support tickets marked urgent are reviewed within two business hours. Standard tickets are reviewed within one business day.
Customer exports are retained for thirty days. Access requires a verified project role. The retention schedule excludes audit logs.
Model monitoring compares live feature distributions with the training reference. A drift alert triggers review, not automatic retraining.
